Here’s a **typical structure of the workout plan you’d get inside the entity["company","Mad Muscles","fitness app"] app** (note that it is **personalized** based on your profile, goals, schedule, and equipment, so what you see in the app will differ slightly for you) citeturn0search2

### 📌 Core Workout Plan Overview

**1. Personalized Daily Workouts**  
Each day you open the app you’ll get a tailored session based on your goals (build muscle, lose weight, get shredded, etc.). You’ll see:  
- **What body part you’re training**  
- **How long the session will take**  
- **List of exercises with video tutorials and instructions**  
- **Equipment needed (if any)**  
This is all generated automatically for you citeturn0search24

**2. Exercise Variety**  
Workouts include a mix of:  
- **Strength training** (classic resistance work)  
- **High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT)**  
- **Calisthenics** (bodyweight strength)  
- **Tai Chi or mindful movement**  
- **Chair workouts or gentle sessions**  
- **Indoor walking routines**  
These can be swapped based on your preferences citeturn0search21

**3. Weekly Schedule**  
You choose how many days you want to train, and the app adjusts your weekly plan. You can also change your workout days any time citeturn0search3

---

### 📅 Example Week (Typical Themes)

Below is a *general example* of how a week could be structured — this isn’t exact from the app but reflects the kinds of workouts Mad Muscles generates:

| Day | Workout Type | Focus |
|-----|--------------|-------|
| Monday | Strength | Upper body strength work (push/pull) |
| Tuesday | HIIT | Cardio + fat burn |
| Wednesday | Calisthenics | Full-body bodyweight movements |
| Thursday | Strength | Lower body & core |
| Friday | Chair or Tai Chi | Mobility / recovery |
| Saturday | Mixed | Optional challenge or walk |
| Sunday | Rest | Recovery day |

> The app picks exact exercises, reps, and sets for you based on your specific goals citeturn0search18

---

### 🧠 What Each Session Includes

For *each* workout day, the app will show you:

✅ Clear instructions and **video demonstrations**  
✅ Estimated **workout duration**  
✅ **Progress metrics** (calories, steps, consistency)  
✅ Option to **swap exercises** if something doesn’t suit you  
All guided so that you don’t have to plan on your own citeturn0search5

---

### 🏋️ Optional Program Types You Can Switch To  
Inside your profile you can change your workout type to match your preference:

- HIIT  
- Strength  
- Calisthenics  
- Chair Yoga / Chair Workouts  
- Basic programs (short daily routines)  
- Indoor walking  
- Military-style workouts  
- Tai Chi variations  
- Senior-friendly routines  
This lets you adjust focus over time citeturn0search21

---

### Summary

**Your Mad Muscles workout plan is:**
- Tailored to your goals and schedule  
- A mix of strength, cardio, mobility, and functional sessions  
- Delivered day-by-day inside the app  
- Adjustable for intensity, preference, and equipment availability  
- Supported with demo videos and cues citeturn0search2

---

If you want, tell me **your specific goal** (muscle gain, fat loss, beginner vs advanced, equipment you have) and I can mock up a **custom weekly workout plan based on that**.

### What Mad Muscles focuses on
- **Strength & muscle building**
  Progressive workouts using bodyweight, dumbbells, or gym equipment.
- **Fat loss & toning**
  Training plans designed to burn fat while preserving or building lean muscle.
- **Beginner-friendly fitness education**
  How to perform exercises safely, with form cues and progression guidance.
- **Short, consistent workouts**
  Many programs are designed to fit into busy schedules (20–45 minutes).
- **Home or gym flexibility**
  You can follow plans at home or in a gym setting.
- **Basic nutrition guidance**
  High-level advice around calories, protein, and healthy habits (not clinical nutrition).

### What it does *not* deeply teach
- Advanced athletic performance programming
- Medical or therapeutic fitness
- Highly personalized coaching beyond app inputs
- Deep nutrition science or meal planning at a professional level

### Best fit for
- Beginners or intermediates who want **clear structure**
- People restarting fitness or building consistency
- Users who prefer **guided plans over DIY workouts**

If you want, tell me **why you’re asking** (personal fitness, comparing apps, or evaluating it for clients). I can break down whether Mad Muscles actually fits your goal or suggest a better alternative.
